### Staying Alert
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-jan-30-31-2010-11625612.html
Passage: 1 Kings 4:29-34
Points:
- The mind functions like a muscle and must be actively exercised to avoid dullness.
- Reading widely and thoughtfully expands understanding and combats sluggish thinking.
- Engaging in meaningful, probing conversations sharpens the intellect through constructive dialogue.
- Writing down reflections and ideas helps clarify thinking and articulate personal convictions.

### The Glory of Solomon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/glory-of-solomon
Passage: 1 Kings 4:20-34
Points:
- Solomon’s kingdom and renowned wisdom marked a notable high point in God fulfilling His promises to Abraham.
- People and monarchs from all nations traveled to Israel to learn from Solomon's God-given insight.
- Solomon's extensive proverbs demonstrated keen, theological reflection on the natural world.
- Solomon's human limitations point ahead to Jesus Christ, who perfectly fulfills God's covenant blessings for all nations.
